summary: The ChangeReminderNoMaster module allows users to change their forgotten password security question through a web interface. It involves input validation, displaying warnings and errors, and handling user sessions.
purpose: To provide a mechanism for users to change their forgotten password security question, ensuring secure handling and validation of inputs and sessions.

fields.name: txtReminderQuestion
fields.description: Input field for new reminder question

fields.name: ddReminderQuestion
fields.description: Dropdown for selecting a reminder question

fields.name: txtAnswer
fields.description: Input field for the answer to the reminder question

workflows.name: Change Reminder Question
steps: User accesses the Change Reminder Question page.
User enters the current password and selects or enters a new reminder question.
User provides an answer to the reminder question.
If valid, the system updates the reminder question.
System redirects the user to appropriate page based on the session.

business_rules: The reminder question must be at least 10 characters long if entered manually.
The answer must be at least 4 characters long.
validations: Entered reminder question must be at least 10 characters.
Selected reminder question cannot be the default blank option.
Answer must be at least 4 characters.
conditions: User's session type determines the redirect page.
system_behavior: Display error if current password is not entered.
Display error if reminder question is less than 10 characters.
Display error if answer is less than 4 characters.
dependencies: Resources for error messages and labels.
exceptions: Invalid input will prevent the reminder question change.
